rule: Player hit (Player::Damage order): knockback velocity first (damage-def knockback, default 20, scaled by a global cvar and attacker push scale), with a no-counter timer clamped 50-200 ms; then armour-soak sound (rate-limited 200 ms); burn and no-air sounds; then view feedback if alive and the view-effect cvar is on, skipped if the last impulse was under 150 ms ago: double-vision time, head kick time and amplitude from the blow direction, screen blob time, position, size and material; health damage applied last. Monster pain (Actor::Pain): debounce, then pain sound by health band (75, 50, 25), then pain animation only if allowed, not in the pain window, and damage passes the pain threshold. Shake: sound-driven view jitter scaled by the summed shake amplitude at the listener, and event-driven FX_SHAKE kick to players within a distance, with an optional radial push.
keep: Camera kick follows the hit direction
Screen blob placed on the side the hit came from
Short impulse lock so rapid hits do not stack the view
Pain sound chosen by health band, with a debounce
change: Drop the double-vision effect (readability on a small screen)
Keep the kick small and one event per hit, not stacked
Knockback becomes a server-verified tile move, not a free velocity
Our own blob art, kick numbers, names and timing
look_test: Same duel scene as the other donor's test (dummy and three attackers from left, right and front). Three profiles: X sound and a white fade only; Y small direction kick plus a blob on the hit side; Z Y plus a 150 ms impulse lock. Dom says which profile shows which side hit him within one second, without discomfort. No release rows.
